what: The tracker is GitHub Issues or Linear, chosen per target, with review and merge on GitHub; the kit depends on the target's tracker.
why: Owner ruling (Tom, 2026-10-22, issue #82): feather works with Linear directly so it can run on Turbo-Outreach; the tracker is set per target in .octo-feather.toml, tracker work lives in packaged skills (github-pr, github-issues, linear) behind fixed script names, and ADR 0004 and 0011 were corrected in place to match.
evidence: Corrected ADR 0004 says the tracker is GitHub Issues or Linear, chosen per target, and ADR 0011 that a Linear lane's key is its lowercased ticket key, while the spec as accepted says 'GitHub Issues as the tracker (ADR 0004)' and 'is not: Linear or a second tracker' (is-tracker); the accepted criteria cannot pass on a Linear target, which Turbo-Outreach is.
